newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian man killed while answering nature's call.
newsitem.headline: Australian man killed while answering nature's call.

text.p: An Australian man has died after being hit on the head by a falling tree branch while he was relieving himself, ambulance services said on Saturday.
The man was standing under a tree in a park in a Melbourne suburb on Friday night, an ambulance spokesman told reporters.
"He'd stopped in some bushes apparently to relieve himself and a branch of about half a metre (one and a half feet) in diameter hit him," the spokesman said.
"He was dressed in evening clothes and seemed to have been out somewhere last night."
The spokesman said ambulance officers found the man dead from severe head injuries.
The man's name was not released but the spokesman said he was aged in his mid-30s.
